name: Mazagon Dock

snapshot.about: Constructs and repairs warships, submarines, commercial vessels, and offshore structures for defense and commercial clients.

narrative: Management delivered on revenue growth, achieving ₹13,006 crore in FY26 against a ₹12,500 crore target. However, profitability diverged sharply in Q2 FY27, with net profit falling 53.8% to ₹346 crore and EBITDA margin dropping to 8.0%.

promises.metric: Order inflow for 3 additional P-75 submarines
promises.statement: Management is confident of securing the order for three additional P-75 submarines before 31st March 2025.

said.quote: Additional submarines, we are quite hopeful that we are confident that it can be done before 31st March this year

actual_source.quote: We are expecting the P-75 additional submarines and the P-75(I) submarines contract to be signed in this financial year. And that is expected to increase our order book from the present Rs. 32,000 crore to more than Rs. 1.25 lakh crores

promises.note: Submarine order was not secured by March 2025 as expected.
